scopeNote: Independent continuation audit preserves all 77 original capability contracts and the 24 existing mission contracts, and adds three distinct omitted issue-level capabilities: data-quality resolution, caregiver handoff, and prospective prediction evaluation. There are 103 required and one desired contracts. Detailed criteria and duplicate mappings are recorded in docs/sat-tracker-scope-audit-2026-11-02.md. Scope remains provisional until pinned source parity, package commitments, deferred recovery proposals and remaining source/test gaps are reconciled. No whole-product percentage is emitted.
